rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day-5 expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3BA grading, with appropriate comments on thinned zona, B-grade ICM, and cohesive TE; slightly overstates image-based certainty and adds minor features not clearly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior live birth, prior IVF outcome, male-factor context, semen data, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo grade and patient factors; only minor issues are some speculative discussion around male factor and maturity yield without direct evidence.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner grading interpretation, including SET, luteal support, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 31; a few suggestions are more practice-pattern based than guideline-essential.
Provides clear next steps for transfer, luteal support, metabolic/endocrine review, and structured future workup if unsuccessful, with practical and case-specific planning.
